scope: Replay of the deterministic embed/consent boilerplate citation guard on every distinct (claim, quote) pair in two previously model-reviewed Dev runs. Diagnostic only; not a benchmark score.
guard: app.qa.boilerplate_quote -> claim code boilerplate_reference (bounded LangGraph local repair, else verification_failed)
limitation: Only 204 pairs, 1 positive. Measures no observed false rejection on this set, not a calibrated rate; semantic support of non-boilerplate citations is not checked by this rule.
